cohort.deduplication: Latest eligible pre-kickoff frozen evaluation by (evaluated_at, recorded_at, evaluation_id); a fixture contributes once per metric family.

evidence_authority.source: Production dynamic_prematch_evaluations records frozen before kickoff
evidence_authority.outcome_join: Only after this file is committed, and only for authoritative FT/AET/PEN fixtures with an authoritative final score.
evidence_authority.missing_field_rule: Fixture is ineligible; identity must not be inferred from status and probabilities must not be recomputed.

metrics.one_x_two_relative_bias: For each of home/draw/away: (mean predicted probability - observed rate) / observed rate.
metrics.acceptance: All three sides must independently have P(abs(relative_bias) > 0.05) <= 0.05.
metrics.asian_handicap_structure: Report AWAY count, HOME count, and AWAY/HOME ratio without smoothing.
metrics.calibration_curve: For each side use 10 fixed equal-width probability bins [0.0,0.1), ..., [0.9,1.0].
metrics.ece: sum(bin_count / N * abs(mean predicted probability - observed rate)); empty bins have zero weight.

power_and_sample_size.derivation: CI width scales as 1/sqrt(N): ceil(2790 * (0.055 / 0.05)^2) = ceil(3375.9) = 3376.
power_and_sample_size.date_rationale: 3376 / 200 = 16.88 months from 2026-08-30; this does not alter the separately frozen V2 look at 2028-02-01T00:05:00Z.

look_policy.terminal: Look exactly once only after both settled N >= 3376 and UTC time >= 2028-02-02T00:05:00Z.

interim_fault_detection.trigger: absolute relative bias > 0.15 on any one of home, draw, or away

look_policy.before_allowed_look: Report counts and evidence-field blockers only; do not compute, emit, log, or serialize metric values.

immutable_boundaries: No result may be used to choose parameters or thresholds.
No model, ledger, allowlist, migration, deployment, Provider, production-write, or V2 runtime change is authorized.
